pieces.title: How a Bean Grows

pages.heading: A seed
pages.text: A bean seed is small and hard. A tiny plant is waiting inside it.

pages.heading: Water
pages.text: In wet soil, the seed soaks up water. It swells and splits open.

pages.heading: Roots
pages.text: A root grows down into the soil. It takes in water.

pages.heading: A sprout
pages.text: A stem grows up toward the light. Two leaves open.

pages.heading: Leaves
pages.text: The leaves use light, air, and water to make food.

pages.heading: New seeds
pages.text: Flowers bloom. They make pods with new bean seeds inside.

pieces.back: What does a bean plant need? Light, water, air, nutrients from the soil, and space to grow.
